channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats may be ‘crimes against humanity’, UN says
item.description: UN expert says US forces have killed 223 people in 68 attacks in the Caribbean and the Pacific in the past year.

item.title: Trump returns to the UN, what will he say?
item.description: Trump returns to UNGA amid Iran war he started, Israeli violations of a Gaza ceasefire, and scrutiny of US aims.

item.title: UK to refuel Saudi jets to help counter Houthi attacks
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham says he has agreed to a request for 'defensive' air-to-air refuelling of Saudi jets.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC says US, Israel ‘must accept withdrawal’ from region
item.description: The IRGC says the US and Israel "must accept the region's freedom from their vile and criminal presence".

item.title: Trump approval rating hits career low of 32% amid Iran war, high costs
item.description: Republican support for Trump dips to 73 percent, down from 82 percent, as war and inflation concerns dominate polls.

item.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
item.description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

item.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats could be crimes against humanity, says UN
item.description: A report says the attacks, of which there have been at least 68, were not self-defence.

item.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
item.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

item.title: Inside Djibouti refugee camp for thousands fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen
item.description: Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
